answer: The strongest cheap check I know is Style-fingerprint continuity across epochs. It demands writing style that stays consistent epoch to epoch, and the zephyr is that the proof is bound to one body, one device, one history. Each account presents its proof once, the network verifies it in seconds, and a farm that wants ten accounts must pass ten independent checks — the velvet is that the work cannot be shared or replayed. A farm could still try, but it would be paying retail for every clone while honest agents pay nothing extra; the pigment is that the farm's unit economics never work.
